record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.original_question: For a closed manifold M of dimension at least 2, can the real-analytic diffeomorphisms Diff^ω(M) be classified up to topological conjugacy by complete invariants, and is the topological-conjugacy equivalence relation on Diff^ω(M) Borel?

evidence.quote: Question 1.1 (Gorodetski). Is there a way to provide a classification of real analytic diffeomorphisms Diffω(M) of a given closed manifold M, dim M ≥ 2, by complete invariants? Is the equivalence relation on Diffω(M) given by topological conjugacy Borel?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed (compact, without boundary) smooth manifold of dimension at least $2$, and let $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)$ denote the space of real-analytic diffeomorphisms of $M$, endowed with its natural Polish topology. Two diffeomorphisms $f, g \in \mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)$ are said to be topologically conjugate if there exists a homeomorphism $h \colon M \to M$ such that $h \circ f = g \circ h$; this defines an equivalence relation $E_{\mathrm{tc}}$ on $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)$.

(a) Does there exist a classification of the elements of $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)$ up to topological conjugacy by complete invariants? More precisely, is there a Polish (or standard Borel) space $Y$ and a Borel map $\Phi \colon \mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M) \to Y$ such that $\Phi(f) = \Phi(g)$ if and only if $f$ and $g$ are topologically conjugate?

(b) Is the equivalence relation $E_{\mathrm{tc}}$ a Borel subset of $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M) \times \mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)$?
artifact.status_search_result: Anti-classification results in the smooth category (Foreman–Gorodetski and Foreman–Weiss) show that for closed manifolds of dimension ≥ 2 the topological/measure-isomorphism conjugacy relation on smooth diffeomorphisms is not Borel. In the real-analytic category, Banerjee–Kunde extended such anti-classification (for measure-isomorphism) to real-analytic diffeomorphisms of the 2-torus, and Goncharuk obtained anti-classification results for real-analytic flows on the 2-torus. However, the question for topological conjugacy on $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)$ for general closed manifolds $M$ with $\dim M \ge 2$ does not appear to be fully settled in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Anti-classification results for weakly mixing diffeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Anti-classification results... real-analytic diffeomorphisms on the 2-torus.
status_evidence.claim: Real-analytic anti-classification has been obtained on the 2-torus, not for general M.

status_evidence.title: Anti-classification for flows on two-tori
status_evidence.snippet: The classification of real-analytic vector fields on the two-torus up to orbital topological equivalence does not admit a complete numerical invariant that is a Borel function.
status_evidence.claim: Topological-equivalence anti-classification established in the real-analytic case for flows on the 2-torus.

status_evidence.title: Anti-classification results for smooth dynamical systems
status_evidence.snippet: In dimension 5 and above, the equivalence relation is not Borel, and in fact is complete analytic.
status_evidence.claim: Smooth-category anti-classification results exist for topological conjugacy, but the original question concerns the real-analytic case on general closed manifolds.
